query:
WITH citizen_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    YEAR(exit_date) as trip_year,
    COUNT(*) as trips_count
  FROM estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala
  WHERE person_type = 'citizen' 
    AND exit_date IS NOT NULL
    AND YEAR(exit_date) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
  GROUP BY id, YEAR(exit_date)
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
)

SELECT 
  hl.city,
  ct.trip_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ct.id) as citizen_count
FROM citizen_trips ct
JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON ct.id = hl.id
WHERE hl.city IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY hl.city, ct.trip_year
ORDER BY ct.trip_year, citizen_count DESC
LIMIT 20
